positive: at least one params token from each required filter group returns 200
continuation token returns additional items or terminal empty state
negative: parser reports non-video renderers instead of dropping them
combined filters are read from live filter state, not manually composed

positive: next endpoint or ytInitialData exposes primary/secondary info, panels, and related/comment entry points
negative: raw playback URLs, signature ciphers, cookies, API keys, and visitor IDs are redacted
related parser supports lockupViewModel and does not require compactVideoRenderer

positive: Show transcript triggers page-generated get_transcript request and segment renderers
DOM fallback yields visible segments when response-body capture is unavailable
negative: direct minimal get_transcript 400 is not treated as transcript absence
timedtext is accepted only when body length is non-zero

positive: oEmbed returns 200 for a public video
thumbnail fallback reaches at least hqdefault
RSS success/failure is independent of channel browse availability
negative: RSS 404 does not mark the channel unavailable

positive: channel resolution yields a UC browseId or explicit terminal state
each mapped tab records params source and renderer types or terminal state
negative: tab params are captured from live page state and not hand-composed
RSS failure does not mark browse surfaces unavailable

positive: playlist browse or HTML exposes playlist metadata plus video entries or terminal state
playlist RSS returns entries or independent RSS terminal state
negative: Mix/radio playlists are labelled degraded instead of treated as ordinary user playlists

positive: trending and hashtag routes expose renderers or signed-out terminal state
negative: empty signed-out trending is recorded as empty_result, not parser failure

positive: video ID extraction accepts watch, youtu.be, shorts, embed, and raw ID forms
channel resolution handles @handle and UC ID inputs
negative: invalid ID-like strings are rejected before network calls

positive: absence of yt-dlp returns not_available and advances the chain when allowed
present yt-dlp command shapes include --skip-download for subtitle/json fallbacks
negative: yt-dlp fallbacks never import browser cookies or emit raw playback URLs

static_channel_rss.conditional_reason: Public RSS is opportunistic and may return 404 for otherwise available channels; RSS failure must not mark channel browse surfaces unavailable.

static_playlist_rss.conditional_reason: Playlist RSS is independent of playlist browse availability and should be treated as a probe, not a reliable happy path.

browser_transcript_panel.conditional_reason: The visible transcript panel depends on captions, UI availability, region, and video access state.

api_comments.conditional_reason: Comments and reply continuations can be disabled or absent per video.

api_trending.conditional_reason: Signed-out /feed/trending may redirect, block, or return empty state; record that as terminal evidence.

api_hashtag.conditional_reason: Hashtag grids can be empty or region/client dependent.

timedtext_non_empty_body_probe.conditional_reason: Requires safe caption metadata and a non-empty timedtext response body.

ytdlp_dump_json.conditional_reason: Optional Tier 4 metadata fallback; never download media or import browser cookies.

ytdlp_flat_playlist.conditional_reason: Optional Tier 4 flat listing fallback; metadata and renderer coverage may be incomplete.

ytdlp_comments.conditional_reason: Optional Tier 4 comments fallback; reply shape may differ from Innertube fixtures.

ytdlp_write_sub.conditional_reason: Optional Tier 4 subtitle fallback; requires --skip-download and no raw caption URL logging.

ytdlp_ytsearch.conditional_reason: Optional Tier 4 video-oriented search fallback; not equivalent to mixed-renderer search.
